title.narrative: Agriculture and Foods Authority (AFA) Trade Services Automation

description.narrative: The project seeks to increase efficiency in the administration of agricultural trade documents regulated by AFA. The efficiency gains are to be realised through reduction in time taken and costs incurred in the administration (by AFA) and acquisition (by traders) of agricultural trade regulatory documents, as well as increase the number of applications AFA is able to process in a give time period
